items.zh: 你觉得加班算努力，还是算效率低？
items.scene: 午休时和同事聊到昨晚加班

answers.en: Do you see overtime as a sign of hard work or a sign of inefficiency?
answers.note: see...as... 把加班摆成努力或低效两种解释，语气中性；适合午休时认真问同事的看法。

answers.en: Is working late a sign of dedication or just bad time management?
answers.note: dedication 与 bad time management 对照，暗含质疑；适合吐槽加班文化时用。

answers.en: Do you think people who stay late are working hard or just working inefficiently?
answers.note: 直接评价加班的人是否低效，判断意味最重；适合关系熟、不怕得罪人时。

items.zh: 你觉得远程办公真的比去公司更高效吗？
items.scene: 朋友在考虑一份完全在家上班的工作

answers.en: Do you really think working from home is more productive than going to the office?
answers.note: really 带质疑，直接挑战“在家更高效”这个说法；适合朋友征求意见时泼点冷水。

answers.en: Is remote work actually more efficient for you, or do you get more done in the office?
answers.note: actually 和 or 把问题落到对方自身效率，要求比较两边；适合讨论实际体验。

answers.en: Would you say you get more done at home than in the office?
answers.note: Would you say 让语气变软，像随口请教而非质问；适合不想显得太强势时。

items.zh: 你觉得三十岁前一定要买房吗？
items.scene: 家庭聚餐，亲戚又提起买房

answers.en: Do you think you have to buy an apartment before you turn thirty?
answers.note: have to 强调外界给的压力，问的是有没有必要；适合在亲戚面前把话挑明。

answers.en: Is buying an apartment before thirty really that important?
answers.note: really that important 带明显怀疑，针对“三十岁前”这个时间点；适合不认同时。

answers.en: Does someone really need to own a place by thirty?
answers.note: own a place 是口语“有自己的房子”，用 someone 泛问；适合和同龄人私下聊。

items.zh: 你觉得年轻时该多存钱，还是多出去看看？
items.scene: 大学室友聚餐，聊起各自开销

answers.en: Should young people save more, or spend more on traveling while they can?
answers.note: Should 把问题摆成普遍选择，语气平和；适合饭桌上泛泛讨论年轻人的钱怎么花。

answers.en: Do you think it's smarter to save now or travel while you're young?
answers.note: smarter 让问题变成“哪种更划算”，带实际建议意味；适合想听对方判断时。

answers.en: Would you rather build up savings or see the world in your twenties?
answers.note: Would you rather 问对方个人的取舍，see the world 更口语；适合轻松聊各自选择。

items.zh: 你同意“爱好不能当饭吃”这种说法吗？
items.scene: 表妹想辞职去做插画，来问你

answers.en: Do you agree that you can't make a living from a hobby?
answers.note: make a living 是“靠它谋生”的常用说法，直接问同不同意；适合正面讨论这句话。

answers.en: Do you think turning a hobby into a job is a bad idea?
answers.note: 把原句落到“把爱好变成工作”这个决定上，直接问是不是坏主意；适合帮表妹评估风险。

answers.en: Is it realistic to make a career out of something you love?
answers.note: realistic 问现不现实，比 bad idea 温和；适合不想一开口就否定她的梦想。

items.zh: 你觉得孩子该不该从小就开始学英语？
items.scene: 家长群里聊起报英语班

answers.en: Do you think kids should start learning English at an early age?
answers.note: at an early age 是中性说法，只问该不该早学；适合家长群里正常交换意见。

answers.en: Should kids start English classes early, or wait until they start school?
answers.note: 用 or 把“早报班”和“上学再学”摆成选择，问题更具体；适合讨论报班时间。

answers.en: Is it worth starting kids on English so early?
answers.note: worth 带成本考量，暗问这么早投入值不值；适合对早教班有疑虑时。

items.zh: 你觉得AI会让人变懒，还是让工作更轻松？
items.scene: 团队刚用上AI工具，午休时聊起来

answers.en: Do you think AI makes people lazy or makes work easier?
answers.note: 用 makes people lazy 和 makes work easier 直接对照，问法最直白；适合午休随口聊。

answers.en: Is AI making us less capable, or just taking the boring parts out of work?
answers.note: less capable 与 boring parts 对举，观点更具体；适合认真讨论AI对能力的影响。

answers.en: Has AI actually made your job easier, or do you just rely on it more?
answers.note: 把问题拉回对方的工作实际，actually 带追问；适合不想只听空泛评论时。

items.zh: 你更愿意留在大城市打拼，还是回老家生活？
items.scene: 老同学微信聊天，问近况

answers.en: Would you rather build a career in the big city or move back home?
answers.note: Would you rather 让对方二选一，build a career 偏事业角度；适合老同学直接聊选择。

answers.en: Do you see yourself staying in the big city long term, or going back home?
answers.note: see yourself 问对未来的设想，long term 强调长期；适合语气温和地探对方打算。

answers.en: Which do you think is better: chasing opportunities in the city or a quieter life back home?
answers.note: 把两种生活摆出来问哪种更好，chasing opportunities 更抽象；适合想听利弊分析。

items.zh: 换工作的话，你会先看工资还是先看发展？
items.scene: 朋友拿到两个工作机会，来问你

answers.en: When you change jobs, do you look at salary first or growth first?
answers.note: look at...first 问实际考虑顺序，salary 和 growth 对照清楚；适合朋友征求建议。

answers.en: Would you take the job with the higher salary or the one with better long-term prospects?
answers.note: 把选择具体成两份工作各自的条件，long-term prospects 偏职业发展；适合比较机会时。

answers.en: What matters more to you in a new job: the paycheck or where it can take you?
answers.note: paycheck 是口语“工资”，where it can take you 指发展空间；适合轻松聊价值观。

items.zh: 你觉得周末该彻底休息，还是抽时间学点东西？
items.scene: 室友周六早上商量今天做什么

answers.en: Should we fully unplug on the weekend or use some of it to learn something?
answers.note: fully unplug 指彻底停下来、不安排任务，we 让问题像共同商量；适合室友定周末安排。

answers.en: Do you think weekends are for resting or for getting ahead?
answers.note: 把周末用途概括成 resting 和 getting ahead，带竞争意味；适合聊长期习惯。

answers.en: Is a weekend still a break if you spend half of it studying?
answers.note: 用反问质疑“周末学习也算休息”，语气轻松；适合和室友半开玩笑地讨论。

items.zh: 你后悔当初没选另一个专业吗？
items.scene: 大学同学多年后聚餐，聊起近况

answers.en: Do you ever regret not choosing a different major?
answers.note: regret 直接问有没有后悔，ever 让问题显得随口；适合多年后聚餐时聊。

answers.en: If you could go back, would you pick a different major?
answers.note: 用虚拟条件假设重来一次，避开“后悔”二字；适合对方可能不想承认时。

answers.en: Do you ever wonder what your life would be like if you'd chosen another major?
answers.note: wonder 带想象和感慨，问另一种人生会怎样；适合老朋友深夜深聊。

items.zh: 如果能回到五年前，你最想改变什么？
items.scene: 深夜和好友散步，聊起这些年的选择

answers.en: If you could go back five years, what would you change?
answers.note: 最直接的重来假设，问整体想改变什么；适合散步时随口聊起。

answers.en: Looking back five years, what's the one thing you wish you'd done differently?
answers.note: one thing 逼对方挑出最具体的一件事，wish 带遗憾；适合聊得深入时。

answers.en: If you could have a do-over for the past five years, what would you change?
answers.note: do-over 是口语“重来一次”，语气轻松；适合不想把话题弄得太沉重。

items.zh: 你觉得婚礼有必要办得很大吗？
items.scene: 另一半在算婚礼预算，问你想法

answers.en: Do you think we need a big wedding?
answers.note: 用 we 把问题变成两个人一起决定，need 问必要性；适合看预算时开口。

answers.en: Is a big wedding really worth all that money?
answers.note: really worth 把重点放在花费值不值，带质疑；适合觉得婚礼开销太大时。

answers.en: Would you rather have a big wedding or a small one and save the money?
answers.note: Would you rather 摆出“大办”与“小型婚礼加省钱”的取舍；适合讨论具体方案。

items.zh: 你觉得送礼最重要的是心意还是价格？
items.scene: 朋友纠结给对象送什么生日礼物

answers.en: When it comes to gifts, what matters more: the thought or the price?
answers.note: the thought 指心意，和 the price 直接对照；适合一般性讨论送礼观。

answers.en: Do you think a gift should be judged by the thought behind it or by how much it costs?
answers.note: judged by 带评判意味，句子更完整正式；适合认真争论这个原则。

answers.en: Does the price tag matter, or is it really the thought that counts?
answers.note: the thought that counts 是常用口语，price tag 指价格；适合朋友间轻松聊。

items.zh: 你同意“朋友之间最好别借钱”吗？
items.scene: 发小开口借钱，你有点为难

answers.en: Do you agree that friends shouldn't lend each other money?
answers.note: 直接问同不同意“朋友别互相借钱”，lend 指向借钱行为；适合讨论原则。

answers.en: Is it a bad idea to lend money to a friend?
answers.note: bad idea 更直接，问借钱这个做法明不明智；适合已经有人开口借钱时。

answers.en: Do you think money and friendship are better kept separate?
answers.note: keep separate 是“分开处理”的委婉说法，不直接说借不借；适合顾及情面时。

items.zh: 你觉得人到三十就该稳定下来吗？
items.scene: 表姐辞掉稳定工作，准备去旅行

answers.en: Do you think people should have their lives together by thirty?
answers.note: have their lives together 指生活走上正轨，问社会期待；适合聊三十岁焦虑。

answers.en: Is thirty really the age to settle down?
answers.note: settle down 直指安定下来，really 带质疑；适合不认同这个年龄线时。

answers.en: Should people be settled by thirty, or is it okay to still be figuring things out?
answers.note: figuring things out 指还在摸索，给“没稳定也行”留空间；适合态度开放时。

items.zh: 你觉得养宠物前最该考虑什么？
items.scene: 室友想养猫，拉你一起商量

answers.en: What's the most important thing to think about before getting a pet?
answers.note: 最开放的问法，直接问最该考虑什么；适合对方还没养过宠物时。

answers.en: Before getting a pet, what should people consider most: time, money, or space?
answers.note: 把考虑项具体成时间、钱和空间，降低回答难度；适合帮室友理清条件。

answers.en: What's the one thing people always forget to consider before getting a pet?
answers.note: 把重点放在别人常忽略的事上，像在提醒；适合帮室友查漏补缺。

items.zh: 你觉得年轻人该不该听父母的安排？
items.scene: 同事被家里催着考公务员

answers.en: Do you think young people should follow their parents' plans for them?
answers.note: follow their parents' plans 直接问要不要照父母的安排走；适合聊考公这类话题。

answers.en: Should young people listen to their parents when it comes to big life choices?
answers.note: when it comes to 把范围限定在人生大事，listen 比 follow 温和；适合讨论具体决定。

answers.en: How much should parents get to decide about their kids' future?
answers.note: get to decide 追问父母有多大决定权，语气最尖锐；适合觉得家里管太多时。

items.zh: 你觉得网上的评价真的能信吗？
items.scene: 选餐厅前，朋友翻着点评软件

answers.en: Do you think online reviews are actually reliable?
answers.note: actually 带“真有那么可靠吗”的怀疑，问法直接；适合朋友翻点评时。

answers.en: How much do you trust online reviews when you pick a restaurant?
answers.note: how much 问信任程度，不逼对方选边；适合边选餐厅边随口聊。

answers.en: Can you really believe what people say in online reviews?
answers.note: can you really believe 怀疑最强，暗指评价未必真实；适合被差评弄糊涂时。

items.zh: 你觉得“会花钱才会赚钱”有道理吗？
items.scene: 朋友是月光族，又在劝你消费

answers.en: Do you really believe that you have to spend money to make money?
answers.note: 用 really believe 直接质疑这句俗语，语气像朋友抬杠；适合对方劝你花钱时。

answers.en: Do you think spending more can actually help you earn more?
answers.note: 把俗语拆成一个因果问题，actually 问是否真有用；适合冷静讨论理财观。

answers.en: Is "spend money to make money" good advice, or just an excuse to overspend?
answers.note: 把说法和乱花钱的借口对照，批判意味最重；适合反驳月光族朋友。

items.zh: 你觉得每天通勤两小时值得吗？
items.scene: 求职者在比较两份工作的通勤时间

answers.en: Do you think a two-hour commute every day is worth it?
answers.note: 直接问每天通勤两小时值不值，语气中性，不设具体条件；适合泛泛讨论。

answers.en: Is it worth spending two hours a day commuting for a better job?
answers.note: 加上“为了更好的工作”这个条件，变成具体取舍；适合比较两份工作时。

answers.en: Would you take a job with a two-hour commute if the pay were better?
answers.note: 用 would you take 问对方会不会接受，条件更明确；适合探个人底线。

items.zh: 你更看重工作稳定，还是做自己喜欢的事？
items.scene: 朋友犹豫要不要辞掉国企工作

answers.en: What matters more to you: job security or doing something you actually enjoy?
answers.note: job security 指工作稳定，what matters more 直接问价值排序；适合认真聊职业选择。

answers.en: Would you rather have a stable job or one you're excited about?
answers.note: Would you rather 让对方二选一，语气轻松；适合朋友间聊个人偏好。

answers.en: Is it smarter to play it safe with a stable job or go after work you love?
answers.note: play it safe 和 go after 对照，带风险权衡；适合帮朋友分析要不要辞职。

items.zh: 你觉得朋友迟到多久就不能接受了？
items.scene: 在商场等了半小时，朋友还没到

answers.en: How late can a friend be before it becomes a problem?
answers.note: 用 how late 直接问迟到多久算过分，标准交给对方定；适合在商场等人时抱怨。

answers.en: How long would you wait for a friend before you got annoyed?
answers.note: 问愿意等多久、多久会烦，落到个人耐心；适合朋友已经迟到时。

answers.en: At what point does being late stop being a small thing?
answers.note: at what point 把问题抽象成临界点，不直接指责；适合不想把话说重时。

items.zh: 你觉得过年必须回老家吗？
items.scene: 夫妻俩讨论春节要不要回去

answers.en: Do you think we have to go back home for Chinese New Year?
answers.note: have to 强调义务，we 让问题像夫妻商量；适合讨论春节怎么过。

answers.en: Is going home for Chinese New Year really non-negotiable?
answers.note: non-negotiable 指没有商量余地，比 have to 更硬；适合想打破惯例、态度明确时。

answers.en: Should people feel obligated to go home for Chinese New Year?
answers.note: feel obligated 指觉得有义务，把问题放到普遍压力上；适合不想针对家人。

items.zh: 你觉得学英语最有用的方法是什么？
items.scene: 同事想练口语，来问你的经验

answers.en: What's the most useful way to learn English, in your experience?
answers.note: in your experience 把问题限定在对方经验里，语气谦虚；适合向同事请教。

answers.en: What actually helped you most when you were learning English?
answers.note: actually helped 问真正有效的做法，比泛问方法更具体；适合想听实际经历。

answers.en: If you had to pick one way to improve your English, what would it be?
answers.note: If you had to pick one 逼对方选最重要的一个，语气轻松；适合闲聊时用。
